verdict.rationale: Unreal publishes its own generated API references: a per-class and per-function Unreal Python API reference (marked Experimental), plus Remote Control HTTP and WebSocket references with example JSON messages that can be sent to a running engine. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers in-page runnable examples. missing for 10: an interactive explorer or try-it console, examples you can run from the docs, rich C++ API reference evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
